description_en: Queries the list of AI image processing tasks
description_zh: 调用本接口查询AI图片任务列表
name: GetAIImageJobs

parameters.description_en:
The IDs of AI image processing tasks. The value consists of one or more job IDs. A job ID is the value of the JobId parameter returned by the [SubmitAIImageJob](~~186922~~) operation.
- A maximum of 10 IDs are supported.
- Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
parameters.description_zh:
AI图片处理任务ID。由一个或多个JobId组成，JobId为调用[SubmitAIImageJob](~~186922~~)接口返回参数JobId的值。
- 最多支持10个ID。
- 多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
